title: Large Type Catalog
user: A low-vision knowledge worker or older family member who needs to inspect and sort a local photo collection with reliably large controls and keyboard/voice-friendly operations.
smallest_useful_product: Local browser catalog for one folder: huge thumbnails, adjustable contrast and text, keyboard-only keep/reject/tag/rename queue, and CSV sidecar export.
constraints: WCAG 2.2 AA where applicable; local files never uploaded; reduced motion supported.
